summary: This is a Form 6-K by BBVA reporting progress under the third tranche of its share buyback program. The buyback manager, Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG, purchased shares between 13-17 July 2026, spending €1,175.6 million, representing 80.52% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. The program is conducted under EU Market Abuse Regulation and Spanish CNMV inside information notices. This is a routine capital return update, not an extraordinary special situation. Watch for completion of the third tranche and potential subsequent tranches.
